title: Tool Table

serves.summary: The learner picks the tool each step of a classroom project needs (scissors, glue, hole punch, string) and uses it until the project matches its picture, which shows they can use basic tools on their own.

request.objective: Pick the tool each step of a simple classroom project needs and use it, without being told which tool, until the project matches its picture. (SCI004-02-D: Use basic tools independently to complete simple classroom tasks and projects)

problems.ask: Cut the card on the dashed line, like the picture.
problems.goal: The card is cut into two pieces along its dashed line, by scissors placed on the line. A ruler laid on the line or a glue stick leaves the card whole.

problems.ask: Cut out the star and stick it on the blue card, like the pictures.
problems.goal: The star is cut out of the yellow paper with scissors, moved onto the blue card, and joined to it with glue or tape. A crayon rubbed on it only colours it.

problems.ask: Make a name tag like the pictures: cut it out, make a hole, and put the string through.
problems.goal: The tag is cut out with scissors, a hole is punched with the hole punch, and the string goes through that hole. A pencil on the printed circle only makes a dot, so the string cannot go through.

material: a tag is drawn with a dashed line on the paper, with a small printed circle near its top
the end of the string is lying loose

problems.ask: Make the paper crown in the picture.
problems.goal: The crown strip is cut out with scissors, bent into a ring, and its overlapping ends are joined with tape or glue. Scissors on the overlap only snip it; the ends stay apart.
